name: goal-orchestrator
description: Ship a goal (an issue and its sub-issues) as one PR in Claude Code goal mode: intake asks which models and effort to use, whether you will be away, the finish line and the results you want; then /goal holds the run to that finish line while implementer sub-agents work in waves in their own worktrees, every lane passes a gate that re-runs its checks, high-risk lanes get their own review, reviewers check every wave, a UI audit runs before the PR, and a final gate and whole-diff review run.
